findings.text: request_archive duplicates the capability main landed in parallel at the same path (ArchiveReader, imas_codex/remote/codac_uda.py:80: validate policy, refuse excluded endpoints, call run_python_script("codac_uda.py"), classify errors); both descend from the same base, so the merge must reconcile two incompatible APIs at one path rather than land both.

the new persisted branch and the codac_uda addition at imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:5907 have no test, so a regression that reports the scanner's cumulative written count without persisting, or drops codac_uda from the check pass, passes every recorded gate.

only the executor path calls load_script_source, while imas_codex/remote/ssh_worker.py:967 still reads raw script source, so any script declared in SCRIPT_DEPENDENCIES run through pooled_run_python_script would execute without its bundled module.

the graph gate's header names revision a0b16cdab, which contains only the evidence html and not tests/graph/test_archive_catalogue.py, so the graph-marker evidence is a dirty-working-tree measurement; it is sound only because the queries are byte-identical from 1b84dcd0c onward.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 2fd068df; six commits — a docs record, the scanner implementation (1b84dcd0c, 15 files), a docs/evidence and figure commit, the metadata-checkpoint repair (4d4b94e78), one durability test (321c1aaf6), and a final docs commit — 17 files, 2775 insertions; the Cypher statements are byte-identical from 1b84dcd0c to the head.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names independent listing count, no duplicates on a second run, ten bounded confirmations with confirmed/unconfirmed counts, an all_debug partition, graph-marker passage and two negative controls; controller-repeat.log records independent_archive_count 200 = first_graph_count 200 = second_graph_count 200 with duplicates 0, sampled 10 / confirmed 10 / unconfirmed 0, partition all_debug, interrupted_complete false with resumed 180, and graph-scope-gate.log records 1 passed under -m graph, so the gate asserts the stated measure.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a registered archive scanner plus the variable catalogue for one declared cohort in the graph; imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/codac_uda.py:134 implements scan/check, registers at line 431 via register_scanner, and writes FacilitySignal nodes carrying selector, unit, archive wording, metadata_archive, data_archive, sampling_mode and archive_cohorts, so the deliverable is present.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the focused gate as 112 passed (incremental-focused-gate.log), baseline 1 failed pre-repair (incremental-baseline.log), the graph gate, the three deliberate mutation failures, and the live all_debug job ids, and every number I re-read in the logs matches the manifest's artifacts block.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the dispatch record carries an empty write_paths list (dispatch-detail.json), so the exclusive scope is vacuous; the manifest's scope_note records an explicit expanded grant on resume, and every path in the diff maps either to the goal or to one of the five steering items in brief.md.

justifications.durability: incremental-negative-control.log shows a genuinely failing guard (removing the pre-graph save fails tests/discovery/test_codac_uda_scanner.py with assert 0 == 3), but imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:3726's persisted-count branch has no assertion that would redden if it regressed.
justifications.evidence: controller-repeat.log records independent 200 = graph 200 = repeat 200 with duplicates 0 and 10 confirmed / 0 unconfirmed on all_debug, and graph-scope-gate.log records 1 passed under -m graph against a disposable database.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/codac_uda.py:189 follows the registry idiom of the sibling scanners and carries no plan or version label, though imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/base.py:14 lists the scanner types and still omits codac_uda.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/codac_uda.py:134 persists each archive variable as a facility signal with separate metadata and data provenance, sampling mode and resumability, and the live cohort reached 200 graph signals.
justifications.reuse: the change reuses register_scanner, ScanResult, persist_data_access, run_python_script and archive_host_key, but imas_codex/remote/codac_uda.py:34 re-implements the transport that main's imas_codex/remote/codac_uda.py:80 ArchiveReader already owns at the same path.
justifications.scope_discipline: the dispatch's write_paths is empty so the scope test is unfalsifiable, and imas_codex/remote/executor.py:1221 changes a shared module for a section-local need, though the manifest records the expanded grant and each path maps to a goal or a steering item.
